testCases.label: Verify initial Lightbulb state
testCases.description: Checks that a Lightbulb instance correctly reports its initial state when created as either on or off.

testCases.label: Verify required method exists
testCases.description: Ensures the Lightbulb class contains a callable method named get_description, validating that the method is implemented.

testCases.label: Verify get_description output
testCases.description: Checks that get_description returns the correct human-readable string based on whether the Lightbulb is on or off.

testCases.label: Verify set_state updates Lightbulb state
testCases.description: Ensures that calling set_state updates the internal state of the Lightbulb and that get_state reflects the new value.
